executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Base URL is http://localhost:3001 and all pages are locale-prefixed (use /en/...). Resolve test plan placeholders as follows: {{LOGIN_USER}} = test@example.com and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} = Password123! (seeded traveler account). For partner tests, log in with partner@bookly.test and password "password". The seeded published tour slug is hidden-gems-rome-walking-tour (EUR 45 per person). Seeded traveler bookings: BKO-TEST01 (confirmed, cancellable), BKO-TEST02 (completed, reviewable), BKO-TEST03 (completed with existing review), BKO-PAST01 (cancel disabled - inside 24h window). Stripe is configured with a placeholder publishable key only; the Stripe PaymentElement may fail to load real card fields: for checkout tests, completing booking creation up to the payment step is a pass; do not fail a test solely because Stripe card fields cannot be entered. Email is not delivered locally, so for forgot-password and email-verification tests only the request submission step is verifiable. When registering new accounts use unique emails like testsprite+<random>@example.com with password Password123!. IMPORTANT: the database was freshly re-seeded minutes ago; tour IDs changed (tour id 1 now), so never rely on hardcoded tour/booking numeric IDs. Use slugs and references instead.
